WITH payments AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0) > 1 THEN 'installments'
      WHEN COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0) = 1 THEN 'single_payment'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS payment_category
  FROM order_payments op
  WHERE op.payment_type <> 'credit_card'
)
SELECT
  p.payment_category,
  ABS(COUNT(*) ) AS payment_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS payment_percentage,
  ABS(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER ()) AS total_non_credit_card_payments
FROM payments p
WHERE p.payment_category IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.payment_category
ORDER BY p.payment_category;
